messages:
maya: Started a stub postmortem thread for the late-night gateway spike (svc: text-gen-gateway). Please add any missing timeline bits and owners. I created a Google doc and uploaded the initial logs snapshot. :memo:

sre-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED • Pager: PAGER-2026-03-14-38 — text-gen-gateway 503 spike — oncall: @jordan — closed at 2026-03-14T03:12Z — severity: sev2

jordan: TL;DR: DB connection pool exhaustion under a traffic surge from a partner test, caused request failures and retries that amplified load. Mitigated by scaling gateway replicas + applying immediate rate limit to the partner ID. Verified traffic normalized ~03:05Z.

kai: Adding the timeline I have from traces: 02:47Z first elevated latencies, 02:51Z first 503s, 02:53Z error rate > 10%, 02:58Z automated scaling kicked in (but backend DB remained saturated), 03:01Z manual rate limit applied to partner, 03:05Z error rate dropped below 1%.

emily: Customer impact: two paying customers saw degraded responses for ~13 mins, no data loss, some chat sessions got aborted and customers reported blank responses. I flagged billing-sensitivity as low but product wants wording for the external notification.

samir: Some notes for remediation section: connection pool defaults are 100 per DB shard; we saw >120 concurrent connections because of retry loops. Immediate action was to add exponential backoff in client side for partner, but we need a long-term fix.

maya: Ok, we need a draft of the RCA by EOD tomorrow for internal review. Jordan, can you own the initial writeup (timeline + mitigation + what worked/didn't)? I'll coordinate the peer review.

jordan: I can draft. Plan: fill timeline, attach traces/log snippets, write contributing factors, list mitigations, and propose 3 action items. Will link to doc here when ready. Target: first draft by 2026-03-15T20:00Z.

kai: I'll drop the trace query and a short explainer in the doc. Query used to extract the timeline:

```
select timestamp, host, http_status, db_conn_active
from gateway_requests
where service='text-gen-gateway' and timestamp between '2026-03-14T02:40Z' and '2026-03-14T03:10Z'
order by timestamp;
```

jordan: thanks — can you also paste the flamegraph export? that'll help the perf section.

kai: done, added svg to the doc.

emily: For customer communications: suggested blurb in doc under "external notice" — short apology, impact window, mitigation performed, and option to reach support. Legal review required for wording. @legal-bot any hold-ups?

legal-bot: Not blocking — send me the final blurb by EOD and we can sign off within 4 business hours. Flag any customers with contractual SLAs > 99.9% for priority review.

maya: Action items I'm proposing (draft):
- Owner: kai — increase DB pool observability + add alert when connections > 80% capacity. Due: 2026-04-01.
- Owner: samir — implement partner-specific soft rate-limits at the gateway to avoid noisy neighbors. Due: 2026-03-22.
- Owner: jordan — produce postmortem writeup + recommended client-side retry/backoff changes. Due: 2026-03-15 (draft), 2026-03-18 (final).
Please suggest edits or add owners.

samir: I can take the rate-limit item. Will create a short RFC and link it. Probably need one sprint to implement + one config rollout.

emily: I'll prepare the customer-facing blurb and share for legal review. Will also compile list of affected accounts (2 paying + 5 trial) and their POCs.

jordan: Draft uploaded: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xExampleStub — contains timeline, logs excerpt, mitigation steps, and proposed action items. Comments welcome.

maya: Reviewing now. A couple of follow-up asks:
- please call out the retry amplification pattern clearly in the "contributing factors" section (that's the main root cause)
- include the fallback routing test we ran later that verified traffic can fall back to model-variant B with <10ms additional latency

jordan: Added those notes and the fallback test outputs (stdout snippet) to the doc.

kai: Quick technical note: the kernel config on the DB host had a ulimit for file handles low enough that connection churn made resource usage spike; worth mentioning under "environmental factors."

samir: For remediation tracking, can we add the action items to the incident board and tag owners? I'll do that after PM review. Queue name: "inc-2026-03-14-text-gateway"

maya: Yes — please add to board and set reminder for 2 weeks to check progress.

emily: Scheduling peer review: propose a short sync Thu 2026-03-16 17:00Z to walk through the draft and agree wording for external notice. Who can join? :eyes:

jordan: I can do Thu 17:00Z. kai and samir?

kai: I can make it.

samir: Free then.

maya: Great. Last items before I close this thread:
- owner acknowledgement: kai, samir, jordan, emily — please add a single-line ack in the doc "I acknowledge ownership" so we can capture sign-off.
- evidence: link to archive (logs + traces + flamegraphs) added to doc — jira: INC-2026-314-ARTIFACTS
- sign-off: aiming for engineering leads to sign-off by 2026-03-20 after peer review and legal clearance for customer message.

jordan: Acked in the doc.

maya: Thanks all. If anything else crops up before Thu sync, drop a note here. Closing thread for now but keeping the doc open for edits. :white_check_mark:
